decisions.reason: As a newly launched extension of the firm’s core office offering with clear fit to flexible workplace trends, its option value remains high and the evidence does not yet justify withdrawal.
This chair family is close to the established range and prominently presented, so management would likely keep it while market acceptance is still unfolding.
Although more niche than the core furniture lines, it still builds on the firm’s materials and interior concept, making it worth retaining for another year as uncertainty resolves.

The softer website presence suggests weaker commitment than the other launches, but its proximity to the core lounge offering still makes continued market testing more attractive than an immediate exit.
A high standing table fits the firm’s move toward adaptable workplace solutions and is close to existing capabilities, so the firm would likely preserve this option.

Because the rug collection is more distant from the established offer it carries higher fit risk, but as a complementary interior product with its own page it is still likely to be kept for now rather than dropped immediately.
